name: aircast-cf-bridge-1
description: Public WHEP viewer for Cloudflare-Realtime cameras, independent of aircast-api

SIGN_KEY.description: Paste the **SIGN_KEY** from your Aircast device — Settings → Public viewer (Cloudflare). It signs the public watch links.

DEVICE_TOKEN.description: Paste the **DEVICE_TOKEN** from your Aircast device — Settings → Public viewer (Cloudflare). It lets the device report the live session.
